# Deluxe Logistics Inc. — llms.txt

> Trailer rental marketplace for carriers and owner-operators. Reefers, dry vans, and commercial equipment at flat monthly rates. No mileage fees. No hidden charges.

## What We Do

Deluxe Logistics Inc. rents commercial trailers — reefer trailers, dry vans, and specialty equipment — to freight carriers and owner-operators. Flat monthly rate. No mileage fees. No surprise charges. Apply online in minutes, not days.

## Who We Serve

- Owner-operators looking for affordable trailer rentals
- Freight carriers needing reefers or dry vans
- Brokers sourcing equipment for their carriers
- Logistics companies scaling fleet capacity without buying

## Why Deluxe Logistics

- No BS Fees — what you see is what you pay
- No Mileage Fees — drive as far as you need
- Simple & Fast — apply in minutes, not days
- Flat monthly rates on all equipment

## Available Equipment

- Reefer trailers (refrigerated)
- Dry van trailers
- Additional commercial equipment
